title: Myelofibrosis & Orphan Bio-Delta Wire — Rare Disease Venture Atlas
description: Daily machine-verifiable Bio-Delta wire tracking ClinicalTrials.gov v2, PubMed, NCBI GEO, and RCSB PDB signals across Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis (ORPHA:824, JH2 pseudokinase selectivity) and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF + IL-6/hepcidin iron axis).

items.title: Open Agent Nectar Suite Released: MyelofibrosisBench-v1, 3 HF Parquet Tables & Stateless Hypothesis Stress-Test API
items.content_text: Published MyelofibrosisBench-v1 (30 primary-cited translational reasoning items), 3 molecular/clinical Parquet tables on Hugging Face (myelofibrosis_gene_signatures, jak2_structural_pockets, myelofibrosis_clinical_trials), open computational problems (/open-problems.json), and POST https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/stress-test.

items.title: First-in-Class Mutant-Selective JAK2 V617F JH2 (NCT06313593, INCB160058) & Type II DFG-Out (NCT06343805, AJ1-11095) Clinical Benchmarks
items.content_text: Phase 1 evaluation of INCB160058 (NCT06313593, targeting the JH2 pseudokinase V617F allosteric pocket resolved in PDB 4FVR/6E2Q/8BAK vs WT 4FVP) and AJ1-11095 (NCT06343805, Type II DFG-out persistence breaker) validates selective mutant JAK2 targeting while leaving catalytic JH2 PROTAC degraders and stromal antifibrotics open.

items.title: Post-JAKi Relapsed/Refractory Myelofibrosis Salvage White Space Following IMpactMF (NCT04576156) OS Futility Halt
items.content_text: Discontinuation of the Phase 3 IMpactMF trial (imetelstat vs BAT, NCT04576156) in Oct 2026 per IDMC Overall Survival futility leaves relapsed/refractory post-ruxolitinib myelofibrosis (median OS 11-23 months) acutely underserved for clonal-eradicating and zero-washout add-on modalities (cf. POIESIS NCT06479135, SENTRY NCT04562389).

items.title: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) Positive-Control Reversibility (74-80% CR) & Dual Transfusional / IL-6-Hepcidin Iron Axis
items.content_text: Contrasting resolving JAK2/CALR/MPL-negative Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (74% overall CR and 80% rituximab salvage CR in Mayo Clinic 2024 cohort, with histological reticulin regression in 3-12 months alongside polyclonal CD8+/CD4+ T and CD20+ B aggregates) against persistent clonal PMF stroma (GSE156644, GSE144568) isolates actionable human fibrosis-reversal and ferroportin/hepcidin iron-mobilization switches.
